subject: Kinect + joypads
author: hn6
body:
For me the biggest question with Kinect is how much interaction it has with the joypad. Microsoft have stated in the past that the two are not mutually exclusive.

Obviously they are showing it as a solo device at trade shows and in advertising, so as not to dilute or confuse the controller free message.

Hopefully they make it a choice for the user to use a joypad or not - some situations may not require one (browsing the dash - minority report style), but others may be preferable with one (Driving games, FPS's). I'm hoping it will bring in the casual gamers who want a wii like experience, and be an addition to the more hardcore.
